methodology.notes: Standard tau2-bench text scaffold (llm_agent, default prompts and tools). Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (public FP8 weights, not fine-tuned) self-hosted with vLLM (max_model_len 131072), agent temperature 0.0. Retrieval: AllTools (BM25 + OpenAI text-embedding-3-large dense + sandboxed shell). User simulator: gpt-5.2 via OpenRouter, reasoning_effort low, temperature 0.0. 4 trials, seed 300, tau2-bench v1.0.1 (fc0055d). Execution was sharded one task per process (--task-ids) across several vLLM endpoints serving the same weights. All 97 tasks x 4 trials are included. The runner wrapper stubs only the sandbox dependency pre-check (sandbox binaries were installed and the shell tool ran sandboxed) and points the NL-assertion judge at gpt-5.2. That judge is not used by banking_knowledge, whose reward basis is DB or ACTION only.

verification.details: Standard scaffold, all 97 base-split tasks x 4 trials.
